description: This file implements the core suite management and execution logic for the Ginkgo testing framework, including tree construction, test execution, reporting, and handling of parallel and synchronized test runs.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, managing test tree, execution phases, reporting, and parallel execution.

methods.name: NewSuite
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Suite instance.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones the suite, only allowed before the tree is built.

methods.name: BuildTree
methods.description: Constructs the test specification tree from top-level containers.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the test suite with provided configuration, handling setup, execution, and teardown.

methods.name: InRunPhase
methods.description: Checks if the suite is currently in the execution (run) phase.

methods.name: PushNode
methods.description: Adds a node to the test tree during construction, handling different node types and phases.

methods.name: AddReportEntry
methods.description: Adds a report entry to the current spec report during test execution.

methods.name: CurrentSpecReport
methods.description: Returns the current specification report, including captured output and report entries.

methods.name: GetPreviewReport
methods.description: Returns the current report in preview mode, only valid in that context.

methods.name: failureForLeafNodeWithMessage
methods.description: Creates a failure object with a message for a specific leaf node.
